observations.note: The judge located the row changes and tests through grep hits and then reported each change in place, although the intent says search-printed lines alone make a criterion PARTIAL.
Only 2 of the 7 changed files were opened, so the line-by-line quotes the brief asks for behind each MET could not come from files the judge read.
The scope grade rests on one grep of file names matched to the plan rows, which the judge itself calls unverified beyond name matching.
